name: La novia de mi amigo
source: What shouldn’t happen, but happens. You were only supposed to stay a few days at your friend’s place, nothing strange. His girlfriend keeps provoking you without meaning to. It was just talks, wine, and laughter… until it wasn’t. You know it’s wrong, but she makes it hard to resist.
translation: What shouldn’t happen, but happens. You were only supposed to stay a few days at your friend’s place, nothing strange. His girlfriend keeps provoking you without meaning to. It was just talks, wine, and laughter… until it wasn’t. You know it’s wrong, but she makes it hard to resist.
